positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead of the Design Systems team, contributing to team strategy and roadmap in close collaboration with the engineering manager, product and design partners and native engineers.

Set technical approach and priorities for ongoing development in Sass, CSS, PHP, Typescript and React.

Implemented, tested, and maintained cross-platform design tokens across two web templating languages, three native platforms and Figma using Style Dictionary.

Maintained build pipelines that packaged tokens data for each supported platform, and set shared engineering norms between native and web engineers.

Built a custom hydration library that enables React components to adopt PHP-rendered server markup, which allows components to be written once in JSX, but reused in both single page application and more static server-rendered contexts.

Member of multiple working groups to establish engineering-wide strategy, most recently advising on frontend infrastructure modernization and improvements to monorepo development patterns.

Formal and informal mentor to less experienced engineers within the Design Systems team and to frontend-focused product engineers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Proposed, designed and led the implementation of the infrastructure to support server-side rendered React on Etsy.com.

Rewrote Etsy's internal PHP view rendering system to support asynchronous tasks, so it could integrate with the Node.js React rendering service.

Designed, built and maintained the first Node.js service handling production traﬃc at Etsy. The service dynamically concatenates CSS to reduce HTTP requests and improve frontend performance, even when page styles vary dramatically due to A/B testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built custom software in React and Rails for the recruiting team that's the core engine of running RC. This included an internal email composer and editor for sending custom referrals to partner companies.

Created a website style guide in tandem with a design refresh, enabling more CSS reuse across RC's various pieces of software and speeding up the development process.

Improved the frontend development process by adding LiveReload, switching to Autoprefixer from Compass and adding automated JavaScript linting.

positions.title: Facilitator
positions.description:
Assisted Recurse Center attendees with a wide variety of technical problems, including help with choosing effective projects for their learning goals, finding good learning materials and squashing tricky bugs.

Planned and led critique groups, a new experiment at RC: bi-weekly small group meetings where Recursers could get in-depth code review and discuss the goals of their programming projects.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Spearheaded migrating version control systems from Bazaar to Git. Researched effective migration strategies, wrote documentation and gave training presentations to help the dev team use Git effectively.

Wrote a new JavaScript model layer for the internal front end framework that was well-received and quickly integrated into additional projects.

Implemented a front end build system using Gulp and improved front end practices, including adding unit tests, using CommonJS modules and streamlining our CSS by following BEM conventions and creating a styleguide.

Introduced React as part of development on a new product by integrating it with existing front end code.

positions.title: Web Designer/Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed websites for small businesses, primarily on the LAMP stack. Worked directly with clients to determine their design needs and project requirements.

Introduced better development practices, including version control and automated deployment.

Built software to generate print layouts for a large-format printer directly from online customer orders, automating a previously tedious manual process and streamlining production.
